title: Omukulembeze w’Eggwanga Alondeddwa
intro: Mu kiseera eky’okusoomoozebwa okunene n’okuggwaamu essuubi eri abantu, okulondebwa okw’obwakatonda kwakolebwa. Ono ssekinnoomu, eyasooka okubuusibwa amaaso bangi, Allah yamulonda okukulembera eggwanga okulwanyisa omulabe ow’entiisa. Emboozi yaabwe bujulizi ku maanyi g’okukkiriza n’amagezi agali emabega w’ekiragiro ky’obwakatonda, ekiraga nti obukulembeze obw’amazima tebusangibwa bulijjo mu bifo ebisuubirwa.
clues: Nalondebwa Allah okubeera omukulembeze w’abantu bange bwe baanoonya omufuzi okulwana mu nsonga ze.
Abantu bange baasooka kubuusabuusa okulondebwa kwange, nga bawulira nti abalala basinga kugwanidde olw’obugagga bwabwe oba olunyiriri lwabwe.
Akabonero akalaga obukulembeze bwange obutuufu kwe kudda kw’essanduuko entukuvu, nga mulimu ebisigalira okuva mu bannabbi abaaliwo emabega, ekyaleeta emirembe.
Nakulembera eggye lyange okutuuka ku mugga, gye nnagezesa obuwulize bwabwe nga mbagaana okunywa amazzi agasukka mu sikopu emu.
Wadde ng’abo abaasigala nga banywevu oluvannyuma lw’okugezesebwa baali batono, twayolekagana n’omulwanyi ow’amaanyi n’eggye lyabwe.
Nga nduumirwa, omuvubuka ssekinnoomu okuva mu ggye lyange, ataali mulwanyi wa ttutumu, yalwanagana n’obuvumu n’awangula nnantameggwa w’omulabe ow’entiisa.

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Obwakabaka bwatandikibwawo nga bulimu obugagga n’obuyinza bungi nnyo.
Nnantameggwa w’omulabe yawangulwa, Allah n’awa obuwanguzi.
Ekyeya ekinene kyabonyaabonya ensi okumala emyaka.
outcome.answer: Nnantameggwa w’omulabe yawangulwa, Allah n’awa obuwanguzi.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
